answer_1.quote: The model is asked to predict the answers and the list of conditions if there is any. An answer to the question has three different types: (1) 'yes' or 'no' for questions such as 'Can I get this benefit?'; (2) an extracted text span for questions asking 'how', 'when', 'what', etc.; (3) 'not answerable' if an answer does not exist in the document.
answer_1.outputs: answers (yes/no, extractive text spans, or not answerable) and associated conditions (HTML elements)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate performance of models on the ConditionalQA dataset as a reading comprehension (RC) task. Answers are measured with exact match (EM) and F1. ... F1(•, •) measures the accuracy of the set of predicted conditions at HTML element level.

answer_4.quote: We manually check 200 examples in the prediction of the best performed model FiD and label the type of errors made.
